newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bank shares down after Budget news.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bank shares down after Budget news.

text.p: Belgian bank shares were among the biggest losers Friday following confirmation by a Government source that the 1997 Budget will require banks to pay tax on the amount outstanding in savings book accounts.
In afternoon trading, Belgium's biggest bank Generale de Banque was down 2 pct to 10,925 francs per share with 11,375 shares changing hands.
Kredietbank was down 0.5 pct to 10,275 francs with 12,140 shares traded. The two banks are among the three highest trading volume stocks by value.
The Bel-20 index was flat, down 1.76 points to 1772.22 points, with Banque Bruxelles Lambert against the trend, up 50 francs to 6,160 francs.
